<thought>From the spectrum, the M and M+2 peaks have nearly equal intensities, a hallmark of bromine (79Br/81Br ≈ 1:1). The noticeable M+1 peak (~9 % of M) corresponds to the natural abundance of 13C, indicating carbon is present. No other element shows a distinctive pattern strong enough to be certain. Therefore the definitively identifiable elements are carbon and bromine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Br']</final_answer>
